implementation.note: The queued transition waits for crossing links to be released.

architecture.note: Authoritative ECS reads at the existing structural barrier. Seat identity resolution remains host-owned.

native_api.note: GuardedPolicy accepts native enumerators; VehicleRegionTransfer uses the host seat mapping.

skill.note: Registered region lifecycle skill documents reference enumeration and crew admission.

mcp.note: Native setup-time C++ callbacks have no authored operation.

studio.note: No authored settings or editing surface for native callback registration.

inspector.note: Admission adds no editable component fields.

persistence.note: Fresh pending and dormant loads preserve entity generations, seats, damage and group ownership.

graphs.note: Parking uses the existing fixed tick queue and no authored graph.

performance.note: 100 native GameCore transitions on Mac Debug: p95 transfer with parking 0.149 ms and waking 0.165 ms. No renderer in this measurement.

platforms.note: Verified macOS x86_64 Debug. Other platforms unverified for this stage; inherited Linux arm64 GCC ICE tracked in the PR.

dependencies.note: Adds header-only predicates over existing ECS and vehicle owners. Target linkage unchanged.

headless.note: GameCore commands drive the queue without a renderer.

examples.note: The GameCore native module configures typed codecs, semantic seats and foreign links.

tests.note: Both named CTests passed on the merged tree. See the recorded command, test output and digest.

handoff.note: Separate stage records identify the code commits and executed checks.

documentation.note: Host contract, setup example and limits are documented.

publishing.note: Headless tick admission has no visual output; the World roadmap records the scope.
